body: The former president has said that his plans to increase tariffs and cut the corporate tax rate will result in a boom in American manufacturing. He has said he will impose tariffs on companies that move manufacturing from the US to another country and, in September, specifically threatened John Deere with tariffs if the company doesn’t abandon plans to move some production from the Midwest to Mexico. The idea is that tariffs will make foreign-made goods more expensive compared with those made in the US. But prices can go up for US manufacturers too if they need to import certain parts. And there will likely be retaliatory tariffs imposed by other countries, making it harder for US companies to sell goods abroad. In 2019, Federal Reserve economists found that Trump’s earlier tariffs led to a net decrease in manufacturing employment. In September, he called his proposal to reduce the corporate tax rate to 15% for companies that make products in the US the “centerpiece” of his plan for a manufacturing renaissance.

body: ===>Recap: Posted by AngTayKor > 2 weeks ago | Report Abuse Posted by neohts > | Report Abuse no Hero but a lot of coward selling down. Why willing selling at a loss ? --------------- @neohts, can't say those who cutloss are cowards. Under LKT this stock from 10.00+ to 2.95 before. Last month trader bought at 4.11 n 4.12 i thought it was super cheap liow. Knn today 3.98 if no cut-win I will be buried deep together with those 100m transacted shares bought in September at around that zone. 4 days ago | Report Abuse Now back to the stock market. For defensive trading strategy, a trader has to first decide on the cutloss price level even before he executes his buy order. Staying very disciplined and sticking firmly to this predetermind cutloss price is very important, no excuses, no changing of mind halfway thru, no emotions or indecisiveness especially when nasty things happen. I have encountered some involuntary long term investors here, some bought at 9.00, 8.00, 6.00, 5.00, 4.80, 4.50, etc. Had their cutloss rules been in place, what is a 5 sen or 10 sen small loss compared to losing 5.00, 4.00, 2.00, 1.00? If a trader decides to buy this stock at say 4.00/4.01, his cutloss level must first be decided beforehand. In this case, I think its prudent have a predetermined cutloss level at 3.95 or lower because if price happens to hit 3.95, the stock is in a very weak position having just made a new low with all support levels already broken (3.96 was the recent low). Traders stay very very disciplined to their cutloss rules regardless of whatever false hope fantasies that may suddenly conjure inside their fickle mind halfway thru. The trade has obviously gone wrong, a small loss is the best loss. Decisions made beforehand when in a clear state of mind are usually much more prudent. Decisions made in an emotional mental state during market trading time when prices are constantly moving usually dont turn out well. This is how traders trade without stress, survive in the stock market and preserve their trading capital (top priority). Anything can happen in the stock market. Trade entries, position sizing, cutloss level and exit points all already predetermined. Keep the actual trading, execution of buy/sell orders very mechanical without emotions. The stock market will always be there for a trader to make the next winning trade....... only if you still have liquid funds to buy again and not be stuck/buried. Some very useful parts of my long earlier posts I cut them out here: <Of course trader was wrong before but trader's quick cutloss strategy always in place. Safety First. Defence strategy is more important than attack strategy. You guys should practice defence strategy, then wont end up as an "Involuntary Long Term Investor"> <I do get rejected by her before, but I quickly cut my losses short with no emotions attached.>

The agen­cy's hu­man med­i­cines com­mit­tee, al­so known as CHMP, is­sued a pos­i­tive opin­ion on Thurs­day for Leqem­bi (lecanemab) in ear­ly Alzheimer’s pa­tients who have one or no copies of a form of a gene called APOE4. The com­mit­tee said those pa­tients are less like­ly to ex­pe­ri­ence brain imag­ing ab­nor­mal­i­ties known as ARIA, a side ef­fect that can lead to brain swelling or bleed­ing. CHMP cit­ed ARIA as a key con­cern when it rec­om­mend­ed against Leqem­bi’s use in a broad­er Alzheimer’s pop­u­la­tion in Ju­ly, and when it re­ject­ed Bio­gen’s oth­er Alzheimer’s treat­ment Aduhelm in 2021.

author: mushimushi
body: Hydromethylthionine Mesylate (HMTM) is a medication being developed as a potential treatment for Alzheimer's disease. It works by targeting the accumulation of tau proteins, a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease. HMTM has two main mechanisms of action: * Inhibition of tau protein aggregation: It prevents tau proteins from clumping together, which is a key step in the development of Alzheimer's disease. * Enhancement of brain function: It increases acetylcholine levels in the hippocampus, a brain region important for memory and learning. HMTM has been studied in several clinical trials, and it has shown promising results in improving cognitive function in people with Alzheimer's disease. It is well-tolerated and has a favorable safety profile. HMTM is currently in Phase 3 clinical trials, and it is hoped that it will be approved as a new treatment for Alzheimer's disease in the near future.

author: mushimushi
body: In a clinical trial, an open-label phase means that all participants receive the same treatment, and there is no placebo group. This is in contrast to a double-blind phase, where some participants receive the actual treatment while others receive a placebo, and neither the participants nor the researchers know who is receiving which. Open-label phases are often used after a double-blind phase to continue assessing the long-term safety and efficacy of a drug. They can also be used to collect additional data on the drug's effects or to provide ongoing treatment to participants who have benefited from the drug.

author: mushimushi
body: Short selling is a risky investment strategy where you borrow shares of a stock, sell them immediately, and then buy them back later at a lower price to return to the lender. However, if the stock price rises instead of falling, you'll need to pay more to buy back the shares than you received from selling them, resulting in a loss. Here's what happens if you can't cover your short selling: * Margin Call: Your broker will issue a margin call, demanding you deposit additional funds to cover the losses. If you can't meet the margin call, your broker may forcibly close your position by buying back the shares at the current market price, regardless of how high it is. * Forced Liquidation: In extreme cases, your broker may liquidate other assets in your account to cover the losses from the short position. Types of Losses: * Paper Loss: This occurs when the stock price rises but you haven't yet closed your position. The loss is unrealized until you sell the shares. * Actual Loss: This happens when you're forced to close your position at a loss due to a margin call or liquidation. The loss is real and you've lost money. Important Considerations: * Risk Management: It's crucial to have a solid risk management strategy in place when short selling. This includes setting stop-loss orders to limit potential losses. * Market Volatility: Short selling can be particularly risky in volatile markets, where prices can fluctuate rapidly. * Brokerage Rules: Understand your broker's rules and regulations regarding short selling, including margin requirements and forced liquidation policies. In conclusion, if you can't cover your short selling, you could face significant financial losses. It's essential to carefully consider the risks involved and only engage in short selling if you have a clear understanding of the strategy and are prepared to manage the potential downsides.

author: Balian de Ibelin
body: Brain is 1) Neurons fixed 18 months from birth. Specialized. Does not divide. Dies off as it ages. 2) Glia cells, normal cells that divides and specializes into inter-neurons that synapses with neurons. Forming new memories and keeping old memories in place. 3) Neuron stem cells that produces neurons to replace dead neurons. The Glia cells are actually like scaffolding that holds the entire brain in place. As Glia breaches Hayflick Limit and dies off. Scaffolding disintegrates. A) Without scaffolding holding the structure in place. Newly produced neurons from stem cells are unable to reach their final destination to replace dead cells. B) as Glia dies [Hayflick limit], inter-neurons are no longer produced. Meaning old memories fades off and new memories can no longer be recorded. What is tau? Tau is a precursor protein used to manufacture inter-neurons by Glia cells. Inter-neuron manufacture is the most common activity in brain. It's like RAM in handphones and computers. When inter-neuron manufacturing stops, raw material tau precursors accumulates since it's not consumed by the factory. What we know is synaptic loss first happens. Meaning inter-neurons no longer locking into place. 20 years after synaptic loss is detected. Precursors tau protein can be detected in brain. Reactions are reactants [precursor proteins] LHS and final products [neurons] RHS. The Adenine TriPhospate in the Kreb Cycle delocalises the electronic cloud, [Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle] and lowers the energy barrier so that tau proteins can lock into place. When you remove those tau proteins using methylene blue derivatives like HMTM, the first immediate impact is less inter-neurons will be produced. Trial and error dosage determines how much precursor tau is removed. Sounds bad right? Less tau, less memories. 😁 So how does the Lego block tau help in the entire Alzheimer Event? Is tau relevant to the Hayflick Limit killing off Glia cells? Is tau relevant to stem cell deactivation? Under the best of times, 90% of new neurons manufactured by stem cells dies off before it can navigate the scaffolding Glia cells to lock into place to takeover duties from dead neurons. As scaffolding Glia breaks down due to Hayflick limit, virtually none will be delivered to final destination. All this Alzheimer events has as much relevance to tau as your dog is related to Einstein.

author: alextan5680
body: KUALA LUMPUR (Nov 28): Gaming-to-plantation conglomerate Genting Bhd (KL:GENTING) reported a 57% drop in its third-quarter net profit, as it was hit by higher property, plant and equipment (PPE) write-off totalling RM207.3 million, as opposed to RM1.3 million previously. Net profit for the three months ended Sept 30, 2024 (3QFY2024) was RM223.8 million, compared with RM520.52 million for the same period a year earlier. Revenue fell 11.2% year-on-year to RM6.54 billion from RM7.37 billion due to declining contributions from its leisure and hospitality division. The latest quarterly revenue was the lowest since 1QFY2023, when it logged revenue of RM5.82 billion. Besides registering higher PPE write-off during the quarter under review, Genting’s earnings before interest, taxation, depreciation and amortisation (Ebitda) also came in lower at RM2.32 billion, compared with RM2.73 billion in the corresponding quarter last year. The lower Ebitda was mainly dragged by its leisure and hospitality and power segments, according to Genting. The leisure and hospitality segment saw its profit before tax (PBT) fall 37% to RM1.5 billion during the quarter, while the power segment’s PBT declined 24% to RM100.6 million. No dividend was declared for the latest quarter. For the nine months of FY2024, the group’s net profit rose 35.1% year-on-year to RM1.05 billion from RM779.1 million, as revenue grew 5% to RM20.84 billion from RM19.85 billion. Lower Ebitda across leisure and hospitality segment, except for the UK and Egypt Under its leisure and hospitality segment, Resorts World Sentosa (RWS) in Singapore recorded lower revenue and Ebitda during the quarter, mainly driven by lower VIP rolling volume and win rate. Meanwhile, its sister resort, Resorts World Genting (RWG), notched lower Ebitda primarily due to higher operating expenses. Its UK and Egypt businesses saw higher revenue and Ebitda during the quarter due to higher volume of business. However, lower Ebitda was recorded in Resorts World New York City and Resorts World Bimini, mainly due to lower revenue and higher operating and payroll-related expenses. “RWLV [Resorts World Las Vegas] remains focused on operations and profitability in 3Q24. Hotel occupancy and Average Daily Rate (“ADR”) in 3Q24 were 85.1% and USD244 respectively compared with 91.1% and USD246 in 3Q23,” said Genting in the results announcement. An abnormally hot summer in Las Vegas and economic uncertainty in an election year impacted results in 3QFY2024. Power, plantation disappoint, but investments and others rises to the occasion Genting’s power division saw its PBT decline to RM100.6 million from RM132.9 million last year, affected by lower generation from the Banten plant in Indonesia following a longer outage period of 53 days for its first major scheduled maintenance, which took place between Dec 2023 and Feb 2024, and annual maintenance, which took place in July 2024. Its plantation division’s PBT slipped 1% year-on-year to RM199.7 million in 3QFY2024 from RM202.3 million last year on lower sales volume of palm products, leading to higher inventory levels. Meanwhile, its investments and others segment recorded PBT of RM418.9 million, compared with a pre-tax loss of RM85.6 million in the corresponding quarter last year, mainly attributable to recognition of net unrealised foreign exchange translation gains recorded by Genting Malaysia Bhd (KL:GENM) on its US dollar-denominated borrowings in 3QFY2024, compared with net unrealised foreign exchange loss last year. Genting said the outlook for international tourism is expected to remain broadly positive, driven by strengthening global demand, improved air connectivity and ongoing recovery in key markets. This positive momentum is expected to support the continued recovery of the regional gaming market, it said. For Malaysia, Genting said it will continue to invest in innovative products and experiences, including new ecotourism attractions, which are expected to be rolled out in 2025. In the United Kingdom, Genting said it will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency and productivity, whilst actively exploring opportunities to grow its market share. In the US, the group will focus on reinforcing its market position by enhancing marketing efforts to drive visitation and expand its customer base. Additionally, the group will continue to closely monitor developments surrounding the New York Gaming Facility Board’s Request for applications, which could lead to the introduction of up to three new commercial casinos in New York. For Singapore, the group continued to accelerate its transformation to enhance its destination appeal and visitor experiences amidst a slower recovery of international visitor arrivals to the city-state. As developments progress at Resorts World Sentosa 2.0 (RWS 2.0), Genting will be unveiling new and elevated visitor experiences progressively in phases, it said. Shares of Genting fell one sen

author: ImCK
body: EBITDA/EBIT ratio of 1.72 means that Genting's earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) is significantly higher than its operating profit (EBIT). This implies that a large portion of Genting’s operating profit is eaten up by depreciation and amortization. Depreciation and amortization typically reflect the costs associated with capital-intensive investments (such as hotels, resorts, and entertainment facilities). A high depreciation expense can indicate high levels of capital expenditure (CapEx) on physical assets, but if the return on those assets isn't as high as expected, it could suggest low returns relative to the capital spent.

body: the only real growth opportunity is in the B2B market, rather than B2C. If RW is struggling with margin compression due to high branding and advertising costs, shifting focus to B2B sales makes sense because: Lower Customer Acquisition Costs – In B2B, deals are larger, and relationships last longer, reducing the need for constant marketing spend. Higher Volume Sales – Instead of selling individual units, they can move bulk orders. More Stable Revenue – B2B contracts often lead to recurring purchases, improving cash flow. Less Need for Expensive Branding – B2B buyers care more about functionality and pricing than flashy logos and branding. If RW is spending too much on Western-style branding and traditional advertising but struggling to see strong returns in B2C, shifting resources to B2B partnerships, corporate sales, and institutional deals could be the smartest move.

author: ImCK
body: A game-changing move for its New York expansion would be integrating a grocery store with the lowest-price strategy. This would create unlimited daily traffic, as people regularly shop for essentials. By offering the cheapest groceries, Genting can attract a wide customer base, including lower and middle-income groups, ensuring consistent foot traffic to its casino. This approach creates cross-selling opportunities—customers coming for groceries might also engage in gaming, dining, and entertainment, boosting overall revenue. Additionally, integrating a strong loyalty program where casino visitors get exclusive grocery discounts can further enhance engagement. Rather than just being another casino operator, Genting would position itself as a daily essential shopping hub with entertainment, making its business more sustainable and defensible. A low-margin, high-volume strategy will ensure Genting doesn’t get left behind in the highly competitive U.S. market.

author: AngTayKor
body: KUALA LUMPUR (March 24): Analysts are positive that Resorts World Las Vegas (RWLV), a subsidiary of Genting Bhd (KL:GENTING), will retain its non-restricted gaming licence after paying a hefty fine to the Nevada Gaming Control Board (NGCB). "The fine accounts for less than 5% of Genting’s FY2025 earnings (estimated for the financial year ending Dec 31, 2025). More importantly, we believe the settlement will encourage gamblers to return to RWLV," said Maybank Investment Bank in a note on Monday. RWLV recently said it would pay a US$10.5 million (RM46.41 million) fine as part of its final settlement with the NGCB regarding a complaint filed on Aug 15, 2024. Without admitting or denying the allegations, RWLV has opted to settle the matter rather than proceed to a hearing, citing cost and uncertainty as key considerations, noted the research house. Moving forward, Maybank IB believes RWLV will recover financially. It noted that RWLV’s 4QFY2024 earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortisation (Ebitda) had plunged to approximately US$1.5 million below its FY2023 quarterly average of US$48.8 million. “We believe that some gamblers avoided it while it was being investigated by the NGCB. Our experience tells us that gamblers, whether guilty of wrongdoing or not, tend to avoid casinos under investigation for fear of being investigated themselves,” said the firm. Maybank IB is keeping its earnings estimates and maintaining its 'buy' call on Genting, with a target price of RM3.98, reflecting a 67% discount to its valuation. Separately, CIMB Securities noted that while the fine paid by Genting is the second-largest ever imposed by the Nevada state gaming regulator, it remains within the lower end of expectations, ranging from US$7.5 million to US$75 million. The other terms of the settlement include a commitment to maintaining the enhanced anti-money laundering programme, which will be reviewed and updated annually, with RWLV's independent internal audit team evaluating compliance two years after the settlement’s acceptance. According to the settlement documents, RWLV investigated allegations regarding certain patrons' sources of funds and potential compliance breaches, reporting its findings to the NGCB and fully cooperating with the inquiry, leading to an overhaul of its leadership team and board of directors. In a show of confidence, the Lim family has continued to increase its stake in the company. Since March 12, they have acquired an additional 18.5 million Genting shares for RM60.4 million, bringing their total recent purchases to 25.7 million shares, or about 0.7% of total issued shares. Their ownership in Genting has now risen to 44.7%. The Nevada Gaming Commission is scheduled to review and decide on the settlement on Thursday. CIMB recommended 'buy' on Genting, with a target price of RM5.25. This is based on an expected 18% annual growth in core earnings between FY2025 and FY2027, along with a possibility of Resorts World New York City securing a full casino licence by the end of 2025. body: Previously I was expecting USD300/share and above if UK Conditional Approval, USD400/share if Full Approval. Taurx did placed out abt USD110m worth of new shares to Chinese and Korean buyers at USD200/share valuation back in 2019. Hence USD300/share after UK approval is really on the very low side. It seems like regulators giving HMTM Full Approval is a long shot, Taurx is now aiming for Conditional Approval for UK, EU, USA. At AGM, I spoke to a Taurx Director during buffet time. He is expecting USD400/share deal after successful UK Conditional Approval, which in my opinion is not impossible to achieve. Valuation is never cheap after successful regulatory approval. Nobody see Taurx up at the moment due to non statistical significance of primary endpoints for lucidity trial (placebo issues). However, if UK is approved, mkt will start to semi-price in EU approval also. The very first respectable approval from a country like UK can give additional up boost in valuation not because of merely UK AD patient population (0.9m currently), but more of the immediate potential of further securing EU, USA, China approvals. Potential buyers can see the advantages of orally taken pill without side effects and without costly scans/ neuro consultations, hence HMTM will be the first in line treatment that can be widely rolled out very quickly with very huge patient acceptance/penetration rate. In UK's case, we estimate there are abt 50% more AD population in existence (meaning 0.45m of extra MCI patients) still not diagnosed yet. Once a very safe and credible AD dtug is commercialised, more of these "forgetful old folks" will come forward and get proper medical diagnosis which will put them into Mild Cognitive Impaiment MCI patient group. HMTM's drug price will be the lowest and no extra hidden cost. No need costly PET / MRI scans, just take the supply of HMTM pills go home and come back 6 months later for next consultation and prescription. Lecanemab's price of USD26/yr is only the drug price. body: https://www.thestar.com.my/business/business-news/2025/04/07/genting-moves-past-las-vegas-headwinds

author: neohts
body: ETALING JAYA: Genting Bhd is at an inflection point, where a successful turnaround of Resorts World Las Vegas (RWLV) could serve as a significant catalyst for rerating. According to Phillip Capital Research, the recent board refresh and resolution of legal headwinds appear to have laid the groundwork for the next leg of growth. Recently, RWLV agreed to pay a US$10.5mil fine to settle allegations of non-compliance with federal anti-money laundering laws, with the settlement terms having been reviewed and approved by the Nevada Gaming Commission. “We view this settlement as somewhat positive, as we believe it will help mitigate any further negative impact on GENM’s bid for a downstate casino license. As part of the remediation efforts, RWLV has undergone significant leadership changes in recent months, including the appointment of a new C-suites,” the research house said. RWLV currently accounts for 6% to group earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA), down from 10% in 2023. “Management is sharpening its focus on driving profitability, with a renewed emphasis on cost discipline and targeted marketing. “Although we have revised our RWLV EBITDA forecasts downwards for 2025-2027 by 14%-21% to US$181mil/US$193mil/US$210mil, these still represent a meaningful improvement over the US$107mil recorded in 2024,” Phillip Capital said. It added that Genting continues to generate steady annual cash flows of RM7bil to RM8bil, and a potential turnaround at RWLV could alleviate valuation pressure. Phillip Capital pointed out that Genting is trading at a 46% holding company discount, compared to an average discount of 40% over the past five years, further highlighting its appeal. “Current valuation overlooks the upside potential from TauRx, which remains underappreciated due to its complex timeline and mixed clinical results,” it added. Genting has a 20.3% stake in TauRx Pharmaceuticals Ltd, which is coming up with treatment to combat Alzheimer's disease and awaiting approval from the authorities. According to the research house, TauRx is currently under regulatory review by the United Kingdom Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency, which has requested further clarification. “The following key milestone in April /May is expected to provide more clarity on the regulatory pathway. “Based on our previous forecasts, TauRx’s revenue potential could range between US$480mil–US$3.6bil upon successful commercialisation, which would value Genting’s 20.3% equity stake in TauRx at RM1.06– RM2.64/share,” it said. The research house has lowered its earnings forecast for 2025-2027 by 19%-23%, reflecting updated Genting Malaysia Bhd forecasts, lower RWLV contributions, and higher interest expense. “Overall, we project Genting’s core profit after tax and minority interests’ growth of 21%/25%/31% for 2025-2027, albeit from a low base. We maintain our ‘buy’ rating with a lower sum-of-parts-derived target price of RM3.55 from RM4.15,” it added. The research house said the key earnings growth driver remains its gaming and leisure operations, with potential upside from TauRx. However, key risk includes include weaker-than-expected earnings contributions from its subsidiaries, lower-than-expected win rates, rising operational costs, and a decline in non-gaming revenue.

body: Despite its late stage, TauRx has faced unique challenges in the development of LMTX. It has not been possible for TauRx to run a placebo-controlled trial in which the participants remain blind to their treatment arm due to the properties of the drug, which causes urinary discolouration, and as such, the pivotal LUCIDITY trial was not placebo-controlled, following guidance from regulators who discourage use of a “true placebo.” Due to the lack of traditional efficacy data compared with placebo in a randomised trial, key opinion leaders (KOLs) previously interviewed by GlobalData have been generally less optimistic about the prospects of LMTX. To get around this challenge, TauRx has conducted an analysis using placebo trial data from contemporary Alzheimer’s disease trials available in the Critical Path in Alzheimer’s Disease (CPAD) database. author: AngTayKor
body: 9 April 2025 Research finds tablet could slow progress of Alzheimer's disease over 18-month period Researchers have reported a potential oral treatment for Alzheimer’s disease that slowed its progression over a period of at least 18 months. Developed by Singaporean company TauRx Pharmaceutics Ltd, the scientists based in Aberdeen report that hydromethylthionine mesylate (HMTM) could be the first oral treatment for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) that targets the tau protein pathology – if it is approved by regulators. The findings were revealed at leading international conference AD/PD 2025 in Vienna, which concluded on Saturday. At the event, TauRx Pharmaceuticals CEO and co-founder Professor Claude Wischik outlined work which compared results from HMTM’s recent Phase 3 trial with placebo data from closely matched subjects available from the Critical Path in AD (CPAD) Institute database, which contains information from nearly 10,000 patients that have taken part in 36 global trials. Prof Wischik, who led the research, said: “The results, which were consistent across three different analyses comparing HMTM with external data, show that HMTM is effective in reducing clinical decline and brain atrophy progression over a period of at least 18 months, with potentially clinically meaningful treatment benefits lasting up to two years. “We believe that HMTM has the potential to be a safe and accessible oral treatment option for early to mild/moderate AD which could be delivered with minimal patient and physician burden. “Although this is not a cure, the research suggests that starting HMTM treatment early in the disease process can substantially delay progression. The combination of a strong safety profile, as evidenced from trials involving more than 3,000 patients, and oral administration leads us to believe we have a drug that people would be able to take in the same way they take other prescription medication.” TauRx has submitted a Marketing Authorisation Application for HMTM to the UK’s Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA), while the company is also engaged with the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) to assess the suitability of the medicine for use on the NHS. The comparison using the ADAS-cog13 scoring system, which measures the ability to undertake tasks such as recalling words and remembering test instructions, showed patients with early disease taking HMTM did not decline significantly from their baseline score over 18 months, in contrast to the substantial decline seen in the CPAD placebo data. In addition, examination of the Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR) scale used to provide a global assessment of dementia severity showed similar results, with progression of brain atrophy, an objective indicator of neurodegeneration, also significantly reduced for the HMTM data. Tau protein has been at the forefront of Prof Wischik’s work since his discovery in 1988 that the Alzheimer tangle was made up of abnormally assembled tau protein forming destructive filaments inside nerve cells in the brain. While several other drugs have focused on amyloid protein, HMTM has a different mode of action in that it targets the abnormal assembly of tau protein. It is also the only oral tau therapeutic to have completed Phase 3 trials.

author: AngTayKor
body: From a SG analyst who attended GenS' AGM: <<I attended the Genting Singapore AGM. It was a peculiar meeting. Management continued to list the advantages Marina Bay Sands (MBS) had over its casino. They said MBS enjoyed a great location near the city, two MRT lines connecting to a station just beneath the resort and was surrounded by 30k rooms (Sentosa 5k) that feed especially higher spending business travellers into its casino. The second interesting comment was shareholders complained that the stock was cheap as analysts here were too young to understand the company and management should speak more to foreign analysts. Since I am old, I believe Genting Singapore is de-rated due to the weak results -- 2H24 was down around 32% YoY. There is a planned S$6.8bn investment for RWS 2.0 to revamp the resort with new hotels, rides and experiences. This is higher than the current S$5bn of fixed assets implying depreciation could double. These investments to attract the affluent may not reverse the loss in gaming market share to MBS of around 1% point per year over the past five years. We think the bigger opportunity for Genting will be the Greater Southern Waterfront. There will be new homes, parks, offices and tourist destinations that can feed more visitors as RWS 2.0 is completed by 2029.>>

author: AngTayKor
body: Posted by AngTayKor > 3 days ago | Report Abuse From a SG analyst who attended GenS' AGM: <<I attended the Genting Singapore AGM. It was a peculiar meeting. Management continued to list the advantages Marina Bay Sands (MBS) had over its casino. They said MBS enjoyed a great location near the city, two MRT lines connecting to a station just beneath the resort and was surrounded by 30k rooms (Sentosa 5k) that feed especially higher spending business travellers into its casino. The second interesting comment was shareholders complained that the stock was cheap as analysts here were too young to understand the company and management should speak more to foreign analysts. Since I am old, I believe Genting Singapore is de-rated due to the weak results -- 2H24 was down around 32% YoY. There is a planned S$6.8bn investment for RWS 2.0 to revamp the resort with new hotels, rides and experiences. This is higher than the current S$5bn of fixed assets implying depreciation could double. These investments to attract the affluent may not reverse the loss in gaming market share to MBS of around 1% point per year over the past five years. We think the bigger opportunity for Genting will be the Greater Southern Waterfront. There will be new homes, parks, offices and tourist destinations that can feed more visitors as RWS 2.0 is completed by 2029.>>

author: eagleye
body: Read, digest, analyze, decide, TAKE ACTION Genting Malaysia Berhad has finalized its $80.7 million acquisition of the remaining 51% stake in Empire Resorts from the Lim family’s Kien Huat Realty III, consolidating control over a U.S. casino venture that has hemorrhaged $238 million since 2018. The deal, involving a $41 million cash payout and assumption of $39.7 million in debt, marks the latest chapter in a six-year saga of cross-Pacific financial injections. The Deal’s Anatomy Under Friday’s agreement, Genting Malaysia’s total exposure to Empire Resorts, owner of New York’s Resorts World Catskills and the Resorts World Bet mobile platform, balloons to $724 million since 2019. The transaction converts Kien Huat’s majority stake into Genting Malaysia’s full ownership, despite Empire’s consistent net losses and $484 million long-term debt. The financial mechanics reveal deeper strains: Genting Malaysia’s debt will spike 10.4% to RM13.5 billion, lifting its gearing ratio to 1.13x—surpassing regional peers like Las Vegas Sands (0.8x) and Galaxy Entertainment (0.6x). Empire’s Bleak Track Record Empire Resorts’ operational struggles are well-documented. The Catskills property, opened in 2018 to tap New York’s underserved casino market, has faced seven consecutive years of losses, with 2024’s Q1 EBITDA lingering at -$18 million. Despite a 39% YoY revenue jump to $69.5 million in 2025’s third quarter, operating costs outpaced gains at $79.2 million. Genting Malaysia’s previous lifelines, including a $320 million 2023 recapitalization, failed to stem the bleeding. Now, as sole owner, it faces a Hobson’s choice: inject fresh capital into a perennially underperforming asset or risk default on Empire’s $484 million debt mountain. Nomura Downgrade Reflects Eroding Confidence Nomura’s abrupt downgrade of Genting Malaysia from Buy to Reduce signals broader market unease. The analysts highlighted structural issues: Genting Malaysia’s post-COVID EBITDA recovery stalled at 68% of 2019 levels, while Empire’s consolidation could erode margins further. The critique extends beyond Empire. Genting Malaysia’s core Resorts World Genting in Malaysia, contributing 70% of the group’s EBITDA, faces headwinds from China’s slowed tourism rebound. Chinese visitor numbers remain 30% below pre-pandemic levels, pressuring a segment already strained by 12% staff cost inflation. The New York Mirage Genting executives frame the Empire buyout as a long-term play on New York’s $7 billion gaming market, emphasizing regulatory shifts like potential downstate casino licensing. However, industry insiders counter that Resorts World Catskills’ rural location and lack of mass transit links cap its upside. The mobile sports betting angle offers scant solace. Resorts World Bet, launched in 2024, captured just 0.03% of New York’s $1.8 billion monthly handle, dwarfed by FanDuel’s 40% dominance. With customer acquisition costs hitting $350 per user, the platform’s path to profitability remains opaque. The Lim Family’s Exit: A Telling Divestment Kien Huat’s exit—spearheaded by Genting patriarch Lim Kok Thay—raises eyebrows. The Lims, who controlled 86% of the Empire pre-2019, have progressively offloaded stakes amid mounting losses. Their total exit via this deal netted $80.7 million, regaining a fraction of initial investments but insulating their broader Genting holdings from Empire’s drag. For minority shareholders, however, the move transfers risk squarely to Genting Malaysia’s books. Consolidation or Collapse? Genting Malaysia now faces a risky tightrope. Immediate challenges include refinancing $900 million in 2026 bond maturities while funding Empire’s turnaround. Proposed measures, from AI-driven cost cuts to cross-promoting Resorts World loyalty programs, draw skepticism given Empire’s entrenched issues. The acquisition tests Malaysia’s gaming titans’ appetite for global expansion. With Macau-style junket revenues extinct and U.S. regional gaming oversaturated, Genting’s Empire gambit may become a cautionary tale of ambition outpacing acumen. For Genting Malaysia, the true cost of this deal won’t be measured in dollars but in eroded investor trust—a currency far harder to replenish.

body: IMPORTANT NEWS CONFIRMED BY EDGE Genting Malaysia Bhd (KL:GENM) is going to gain full control of loss-making Empire Resorts Inc in a US$41 million (RM177 million) deal from the Lim family's Kien Huat Realty III Ltd, by acquiring the remaining 51% stake in Genting Empire Resorts LLC (GERL) that it does not own. It currently holds 49% interest in GERL, which owns Empire Resorts. Concurrently, the US$39.7 million intercompany loan — including accrued interest — that Empire Resorts obtained from Kien Huat Realty III will be reassigned to Genting Malaysia. Kien Huat Realty III is controlled by Genting group's founding Lim family, led by Tan Sri Lim Kok Thay. author: ImCK
body: U.S loss is because depreciate is more than ebitda This doesn't mean the business isn't generating income; it just indicates that earnings are weaker than expected and the company is investing more heavily (CAPEX) than it is earning (EBITDA). Let's say I buy a new car every month. I earn RM1,000 and pay RM300 in financial costs. I'm still making RM700 profit. However, to minimize taxes, I include depreciation. Depreciation on a car can be claimed over 5 years as a tax deduction. So, even though I'm profitable, I can still show a lower taxable income—or even a loss—on paper.

author: ImCK
body: When Genting considers an IPO listing (especially for a U.S. unit or any capital-intensive arm), they will most likely use EBITDA as the primary valuation benchmark, not net profit. Here's why: Why Use EBITDA for Valuation: EBITDA excludes non-cash expenses like depreciation and amortization, which are high due to CAPEX but don’t affect actual cash flow. It better reflects operating performance and cash-generating ability. Especially in industries with large upfront investments (like casinos, resorts, or theme parks), EBITDA provides a more normalized view of profitability before accounting treatments distort the picture. Key Point: The business might show accounting losses today due to depreciation, but if EBITDA is strong, the valuation for IPO can still be high. Investors often focus on EBITDA multiples (e.g., 10x EBITDA) to determine enterprise value.

author: neohts
body: Genting Malaysia Bhd’s (KL:GENM) proposed US$41 million (RM175.5 million) acquisition to gain full control of the loss-making Empire Resorts Inc from Genting group's founding Lim family has come under the scrutiny of Bursa Malaysia Securities Bhd. The bourse regulator on Thursday slapped Genting Malaysia with 20 questions on the deal, which would see GENM buy the remaining 51% stake in Genting Empire Resorts LLC (GERL) that it does not currently own from Kien Huat Realty III Ltd. GERL owns Empire Resorts, while Kien Huat Realty III is owned by the Lim family, led by Tan Sri Lim Kok Thay. Among the questions posed by Bursa were those that sought to clarify the rationale for the acquisition, justifications for its purchase price, whether any valuation was done on GERL, liabilities to be assumed by GENM, financial information on GERL and Empire Resorts, and their prospects. — Bursa grills Genting Malaysia over US$41m Empire Resorts buyout

author: eagleye
body: Genting Malaysia’s piecemeal acquisition of BLEEDING (BLOOD-SUCKING) Empire Resorts must be seen as one single buyout” IT IS not sufficient for the Genting Malaysia Bhd’s (GENM) board to only seek non-interested minority shareholder approval for the most recent transaction involving the remaining 51% stake in Empire Resorts. By this point, a substantial portion – over US$724 mil – has already been invested across multiple phases into this related-party transaction without the proper approval from minority shareholders. This piecemeal approach to a clearly related and on-going investment should not shield the board from proper scrutiny. The entire series of transactions – starting from the initial acquisition in 2019 through all subsequent capital injections and restructurings – should be considered as a single, connected related-party transaction. As such, a comprehensive shareholder vote covering the full scope of these transactions is necessary. If the non-interested minority shareholders vote against the totality of the transaction, then the board and management must take steps to reassess or unwind the entire deal in the best interests of shareholders. It is unacceptable to frame this issue as “too late” for corrective action – doing so would effectively legitimize regulatory evasion through strategic transaction structuring. Moreover, seeking approval only at the final stage – when a majority of the funds have already been committed – renders any vote procedurally hollow and substantively meaningless. This is akin to seeking consent after the outcome has already been decided and the value already eroded. The integrity of the capital markets demands that companies cannot simply break up related-party transactions into parts to avoid triggering shareholder protection mechanisms. The board should not be permitted to use time or transaction sequencing as an excuse to avoid accountability. I again urge Bursa Malaysia and the Securities Commission Malaysia (SC) to treat this entire five-year investment as a single, related-party transaction (RPT). Minority shareholders must be allowed to vote on the full scope of this deal – and their voice must carry real consequence, including the potential reversal or restructuring of the investment if deemed necessary. Protecting minority shareholder rights is essential to maintaining confidence in Malaysia’s capital markets. – May 12, 2025

author: neohts
body: Genting Singapore likely to see better 2H KUALA LUMPUR: Genting Singapore Ltd (GenS) may see a weaker first half in 2025 before potentially regaining traction in the second half of this year. This is because of the lower VIP rolling win rate, as well as the temporary closure of Hard Rock Hotel for renovation and rebranding work that had impacted its first-quarter bottomlines. Also, according to Hong Leong Investment Bank Research (HLIB Research), GenS’ management had indicated that operating expenses are expected to rise in the first half due to preparations for the hotel’s reopening and rebranding as well as the S.E.A. Aquarium which will be closed for 2.5 months in the first half. “All in, we expect GenS to deliver a relatively weaker first half before regaining traction in the second half of the year,” it said. GenS is majority 52.5% owned by Genting Bhd. HLIB Research said tourist arrivals into Singapore will be supported by the various entertainment events such as the upcoming Lady Gaga concert and attractions. These also include Universal Studios Singapore’s new themed zone called Illumination’s Minion Land, Mandai Rainforest Wild Asia, and Disney Adventure Cruise Ship; and the mutual 30-day visa exemption between Singapore and China. GenS plans to launch The Laurus, an all-suite luxury hotel that was rebranded from Hard Rock Hotel and the Singapore Oceanarium by the third quarter of this year, it said. It maintained a “buy” call on GenS with a lower target price of S$1.10 from S$1.22, based on the financial year 2025’s (FY25) enterprise value to earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation multiples of nine times that is at parity to its three-year, pre-lockdown average. “We continue to like GenS for its undemanding valuation and attractive FY25 projected dividend yields of 6.1%,” it said. While recent results were below HLIB Research’s expectations, it was in-line with Maybank Investment Bank Research’s (Maybank IB) projections. “From the third quarter, we expect operations to be stronger, thanks largely to the opening of The Laurus hotel that will house more VIP and premium mass players,” Maybank IB said. “Going into the second quarter, we expect operations to be seasonally slower after the Chinese New Year festival in the first quarter. “We do not get the feeling from management that the short-lived trade war between the United States and China had a marked impact on VIP volumes in the second quarter,” it added. Meanwhile, it also highlighted Tan Hee Teck, the chief executive officer (CEO) of GenS and Resorts World Singapore, will fully retire by Nov 30, 2025. Tan Sri Lim Kok Thay, who is presently the executive chairman of GenS will assume the role of acting CEO from June 1, 2025 while also retaining his role as executive chairman. Maybank IB maintained its earnings estimates, “buy” call and S$1.01 discounted cashflow target price, noting that the market is presently discounting its huge net cash pile.

body: Skill-based gaming can attract more visitors, especially younger ones. It keeps them engaged longer and increases spending on food, retail, and entertainment within the property. Traditional gaming should become extra income, not the main focus. Compliance risks are rising, and the VIP gaming market is now highly competitive and exposed to AMLA scrutiny. Don’t over-focus on VIPs. Instead, aim for volume — casual players who just want to try their luck. It’s safer, more sustainable, and fits today’s market. Put more effort into hosting tournaments and events. They create hype, build community, and bring repeat foot traffic. This strengthens the overall ecosystem and makes the destination more lively and future-proof.

author: ImCK
body: 1) Dividend + Share Subscription Yield If the company offers a combined dividend + rights issue subscription yield of 5-7%, would any large shareholder or investor want to subscribe at a time when dividend alone is just 3-4%? 2) Genting’s Strong Cash Flow and EBITDA Genting is known for strong operating cash flow and EBITDA, which are better indicators of ongoing business health than reported accounting profits. This fundamentally supports the company’s value and ability to pay dividends sustainably. 3) Accounting Profit is Delayed Accounting profits can be distorted by timing, non-cash items, or one-off events. Sometimes profits are “delayed” due to conservative recognition or deferred expenses/revenue. So EBITDA and cash flow give a more real-time picture of operational strength. This means the market might underreact or overreact to reported profits vs. underlying business reality.

Signal strength when negotiating loans, bonds, or partnerships. Attract sovereign wealth and pension funds that prefer large, stable names. author: johnlim1001
body: 东方日报：云顶何时拨云见日 在上个月5月财报季节，大马博彩业巨头云顶集团由于营运盈利下滑，以及减值亏损增加、账面外汇转亏，集团截至2025年3月31日止首季净利大跌99.22%。其首季营业额也从74亿3133万7000令吉下滑12.42%至65亿零802万5000令吉。纵观近年来的表现，云顶集团似乎在走下坡，何时能拨云见日？ 所谓见微知著，从笔者一些个人体验和观察，或许可推知未来演变和发展。笔者上一次到访云顶，已是十年前的事。近日想上山度假，尝试拨打云顶酒店的客服电话。不料，电话拨了一整个早上都无人接听。一个拥有数十年历史的旅游与博彩旗舰，竟连最基本的客服都无法处理，令人费解。 确实，不少家庭游客在计划前往云顶度假时，常面临“有心无房”的窘境。许多酒店房间优先保留给以积分兑换住房的赌场常客，导致真正愿意付费住宿的家庭客群反而订不到房，只能退而求其次选择半山的民宿。这种做法虽看似回馈忠实赌客，但长期来看却牺牲了更多潜在的家庭旅客。 笔者认为，云顶目前面对的最大挑战，是博彩业魅力的结构性衰退。过去几十年，云顶靠博彩印钞，是本地经济的黄金招牌之一。但如今，年轻一代对赌博的接受度明显降低。年轻人追求的是互动游戏、沉浸式娱乐、打卡景点与文化体验，赌场似乎已经成了长辈的消遣以及上代人的回忆。 同时，社交媒体、手持游戏、NFT与电子竞技等新兴娱乐形式正迅速夺取用户的注意力。相比之下，云顶虽有新建“SkyWorlds”主题乐园与购物区，但其整体IP内容形象与服务体验仍难以与新兴娱乐市场抗衡。 云顶的不景气，另一大原因是来自周边国家的激烈竞争。新加坡的滨海湾金沙、韩国仁川百乐达斯城（Paradise City）、菲律宾马尼拉索莱尔赌场、柬埔寨的金界娱乐城（NagaWorld），无不在抢占博彩业与娱乐市场的份额。这些国外赌场不只拥有更完善的娱乐设施和客服体验，也享有政府的高度配合。 相比之下，云顶高原虽占有地利，但受限于国内博彩牌照政策，无法全面创新发展，也难以在国际市场推介全新体验。 笔者也发现，近年来不少大型演唱会主办方不再把云顶云星剧场当成首选场地，转而移师武吉加里尔国家体育馆或亚通体育馆。这不仅因容量与交通便利性的考量，也反映出云顶在吸引大众娱乐活动方面的吸引力逐渐减弱。若云顶想重新成为娱乐活动的热门场所，势必要在基础设施、交通配套与场地推广上下功夫。 事实上，云顶并非没有机会翻身。云顶旗下仍拥有大量土地资源、酒店资产、运营经验与国际网络。但问题是，云顶是否敢于彻底告别赌场主导的旧模式，转向综合娱乐生态经营模式。这需要的不只是资本，而是企业管理层的愿景。 既然博彩市场增长放缓，云顶不妨借机重新定位，将高原打造为家庭旅游、团队建设与教育营地的新据点。例如，云顶可以结合主题乐园推行学校与企业配套、开辟露营与生态旅游区、推动免税购物区等，都是值得探索的路径。 注入非博彩想像力 此外，云顶可以打造国内首个山上文化村，引入国际表演团体长期驻场，结合增强现实（AR）与虚拟现实（VR）科技，联手国内外影视游戏团队开发“云顶宇宙”IP。这些想法听起来遥不可及，但也只有注入非博彩的想像力，才有可能为云顶打开新局。 此外，客服是游客接触服务的第一道窗口，客服效率与亲和力将直接影响整体旅游体验与品牌印象。对于云顶这样一个涵盖住宿、娱乐与餐饮的度假胜地而言，建立一个畅通、专业且以客户为中心的客服系统，是至关重要的。 展望未来，云顶依然拥有转型的底气与条件。关键在于管理层是否愿意跳脱传统框架，以长远眼光重新定位企业形象。若云顶能从“以客为本”，强化软体服务，重塑内容核心，并携手创意与科技产业开拓新体验，云顶未尝不能再创高峰，拨云见日。

body: Genting Malaysia Berhad has announced plans to acquire the remaining 10% economic interest in New York-based Empire Resorts Limited that it does not already own, through a transaction valued at approximately US$80.7 million.

author: Joo1818
body: The deal includes a US$41 million cash consideration and the assumption of a US$39.7 million intercompany loan from Empire to the Lim family’s investment vehicle, Kien Huat Realty III Ltd. Although the acquisition is still subject to regulatory approval, it is expected to be completed by the second quarter of FY2025. The move, detailed in a filing to Bursa Malaysia, will see Genting Malaysia take full control of Empire Resorts, which operates Resorts World Catskills, Resorts World Hudson Valley, and the online sportsbook platform Resorts World Bet.

author: Joo1818
body: The stake is currently held by the family trust of Genting Group Chairman and CEO Lim Kok Thay, who also serves as Deputy Chairman and CEO of Genting Malaysia. KH currently owns 51% of Empire’s common stock, with Genting Malaysia holding the remaining 49% and 100% of the convertible preferred stock.

author: Joo1818
body: Nomura analysts Tushar Mohata and Alpa Aggarwal described the latest transaction as negative, citing the absence of a clear turnaround plan and warning that Genting Malaysia would now have to consolidate Empire’s entire financial performance, potentially deepening reported losses.

author: Joo1818
body: Maybank Investment Bank, in a separate note, echoed concerns about the deal’s value implications, calling it the latest in a series of related party transactions that have eroded shareholder value. Similarly, Hong Leong Investment Bank described the acquisition price as excessive, calculating that the deal values Empire at an EV/EBITDA multiple of 72.7, far above the industry average of around 10 times for US-listed casino operators.

author: Joo1818
body: While the transaction will give Genting Malaysia full control over the Resorts World-branded operations in New York, HLIB warned of financial strain. It projects an increase in total borrowings by RM1.3 billion ($310 million), raising the group’s gearing ratio to 1.15 and adding up to RM70 million ($16.54 million) in annual interest costs by FY2026–2027.

author: Joo1818
body: The firm also anticipates that Genting Malaysia’s share of Empire-related losses could widen by RM23 million ($5.43 million) in FY2025, potentially denting earnings by 3.5% over the next three years.

author: Joo1818
body: PublicInvest Research remained bearish, citing persistent losses and market cannibalization following the launch of Resorts World Hudson Valley in late 2022. The research firm noted that Genting Malaysia has been absorbing RM160 million ($37.80 million) to RM280 million ($66.15 million) in annual losses linked to Empire between FY2020 and FY2024.

author: Joo1818
body: Downgrading Genting Malaysia to “Trading Sell,” it lowered its target price to RM1.66 from RM2.53 ($0.39 - $0.60), citing both the earnings impact and ongoing governance concerns.

author: Joo1818
body: Genting Malaysia wrote off its US$426.3 million (including accrued interest) investment in promissory notes issued by the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe in 2018. This impairment loss was due to the US Department of Interior's ruling that the Tribe did not satisfy the conditions to have the land in trust for their planned casino project. While the loan was written off, there have been ongoing developments that could potentially lead to a write-back of the investment. These include: * Changes in US government stance: The Biden administration, with its pro-Native American stance and the appointment of Deb Haaland as Secretary of the Interior, created a possibility for the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe to have their reservation land held in trust again. * Legal developments: There have been legal challenges and legislative efforts (such as the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe Reservation Reaffirmation Act) aimed at reaffirming the Tribe's land in trust, which would allow the casino project to proceed. * Tribe's continued efforts: The Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe has continued to work towards developing their casino, including announcing plans to present a phased development strategy in early 2025. In summary, the loan was written off in 2018, meaning it was considered unrecoverable at that time. However, the situation is not entirely closed. Analysts and Genting Malaysia itself have discussed the possibility of a "write-back" of the impaired notes if the legal and political hurdles are overcome and the casino project can proceed. This would represent a recovery of the investment, but it is not a certainty and depends on future developments.

author: Joo1818
body: Yes, consolidating the financials of Empire Resorts Inc. (which includes Resorts World Catskills and Resorts World Hudson Valley) with Genting's existing operations in New York, particularly Resorts World New York City (RWNY), is generally seen as a positive strategic move that could help Genting in its bid to obtain a full casino license from the New York Gaming Commission. Here's why: * Demonstrates a Unified and Stronger Presence: By fully acquiring Empire Resorts, Genting Malaysia presents a more unified and substantial presence in the New York gaming market. It shows a clear commitment to the state and its existing assets. This consolidated structure can demonstrate to the Gaming Commission that Genting has a comprehensive and integrated strategy for its operations in the region. * Operational Synergies and Cross-Marketing: Full ownership allows Genting to better leverage synergies between RWNY (a video lottery terminal facility in Queens, NYC, a high-traffic area) and Empire Resorts' properties (Resorts World Catskills, a full-scale casino in a more rural area, and Resorts World Hudson Valley). This includes: * Cross-marketing: Directing customers from RWNY to Catskills and vice-versa, creating a broader customer base across their New York properties. * Cost Efficiencies: Streamlining management, operations, and potentially supply chains across all New York assets. * Enhanced Brand Recognition: Further solidifying the "Resorts World" brand as a dominant player in the New York gaming landscape. * Streamlined Decision-Making: With 100% ownership, Genting can implement strategies more effectively and swiftly across all its New York operations without needing to navigate joint venture complexities or minority shareholder interests. This agility can be appealing to regulators looking for operators with clear plans and efficient execution capabilities. * Tax Benefits (Potentially): While Empire Resorts has been loss-making, consolidating its financials can potentially allow Genting to utilize those non-operating losses within its U.S. consolidated tax group, making them a more valuable tax asset. This could be seen as a sign of long-term financial planning and optimization. * Addressing Governance Concerns: The prior related-party transactions and the continued financial support to Empire Resorts had raised some corporate governance concerns. By taking full control, Genting Malaysia simplifies the ownership structure and potentially mitigates future questions about the flow of funds between related entities, presenting a cleaner operational picture to regulators. However, it's not without its challenges: * Financial Burden: As you noted, Empire Resorts has been a loss-making entity for a long time. Full consolidation means Genting Malaysia will fully absorb these losses, which analysts have already flagged as "profit-dilutive" in the short term. The Gaming Commission will want to see a financially stable operator, and while Genting Malaysia is a large and diversified group, the burden of a persistently loss-making subsidiary could be a point of scrutiny. * Competition: The competition for the downstate New York casino licenses is intense, with many well-capitalized and experienced operators vying for the limited number of licenses. Genting's consolidation helps its existing position, but it doesn't guarantee a win. New York Casino License Timeline: You are correct that the New York Gaming Commission is expected to announce the full casino licenses in late 2025.

body: WASHINGTON, June 27 (Reuters) - U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday he would "love" if Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell were to resign, and the president also said he wanted interest rates cut to 1%. Trump said he would not appoint anyone to head the Federal Reserve who would not lower interest rates from where they are, setting perhaps the most explicit litmus test yet for candidates to be the next central bank chief to align with his demands for steep rate cuts in order to get the job. "I'd love him to resign if he wanted to, he's done a lousy job," Trump said, also labeling the Fed chair as "stu.....pid." "I think we should be paying 1% right now, and we're paying more because we have a guy who suffers from, I think, Trump Derangement Syndrome," Trump added. "If I think somebody's going to keep the rates where they are or whatever, I'm not going to put them in," Trump said. "I'm going to put somebody that wants to cut rates. There are a lot of them out there."

author: Michaelchan2024
body: WHY IT'S IMPORTANT Trump has long attacked the Federal Reserve chair over interest rates that the U.S. president wants lowered. Fed chairs have long been seen as insulated from presidential dismissal for reasons other than malfeasance or misconduct, but Trump has threatened to test that legal premise with frequent threats to fire Powell. Powell's term ends in May 2026, and Trump is expected to nominate a successor in the coming months. Trump has in recent weeks said he has three or four potential candidates in mind and he would make a decision soon. Most past Fed chair appointments have typically been made roughly three or four months before the vacancy was scheduled. There are about 10 months remaining in Powell's tenure as chair, and an early nomination by Trump is seen as an effort to undermine Powell's authority by giving voice to a "shadow chair" who would advocate for a different policy trajectory. CONTEXT Trump said he will name as successor to Powell someone who will lower rates. Last week, the Fed decided to leave short-term borrowing costs in the 4.25%-4.50% range.

body: KUALA LUMPUR (June 30): Genting Malaysia Bhd (KL:GENM) announced that a formal bid has been submitted for a casino licence in New York as part of a US$5.5 billion (RM23.19 billion) resort development in Queens. The bid was submitted on June 27 in response to the New York State Gaming Commission’s request for applications for up to three commercial casinos in downstate New York, where its Resorts World New York City (RWNYC) is located, Genting Malaysia said in an exchange filing. “RWNYC is uniquely positioned to transform itself into a world-class integrated resort destination with a proposed multi-billion-dollar investment in conjunction with its bid,” Genting Malaysia said. “This will drive RWNYC’s next chapter of growth.”

author: neohts
body: In a separate statement, RWNYC touted that its 5.6 million-square-foot project could provide tax revenue as soon as July 2026, promising to launch table game and full-casino slot machine operations within six months of receiving a gaming facility licence. The integrated resort will feature a total of a 500,000 sq ft gaming floor with 6,000 slots and 800 table games, 2,000 hotel rooms, a 7,000-seat entertainment venue, over 30 food and beverage outlets, large-scale meeting space and other amenities, as well as more than 10 acres of greenspace. RWNYC said its current workforce will expand from 1,000 existing employees to 5,000 permanent jobs across gaming, hospitality, food and beverage, security, maintenance, and other fields with the new development. Genting Malaysia's wholly owned subsidiary Genting New York LLC owns and operates RWNYC, which opened 15 years ago, offering 5,500 slot machines and electronic table games, restaurants and bars, event spaces and a 400-room Hyatt hotel.

body: RWS’ green and sustainable mall Weave opens to public on July 1 | The Straits Times share.google/jFFiWGRAR697MHBP4

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Resorts World Sentosa’s (RWS) biophilic mall, Weave, has opened its doors to visitors on July 1. The three-storey development, billed by the integrated resort as a lifestyle and community enclave, spans 20,000 sq m and houses almost 40 tenants. Not all tenants have moved in, but some seven food and beverage (F&B) outlets are already operational, including Middle Eastern eatery WeWa, Chinese tea chain Chagee and Taiwanese restaurant Din Tai Fung. Other stores to look out for include a flagship outlet for sportswear brand Adidas and two F&B concepts by Michelin-starred French chef Paul Pairet: French bistro Moutarde and ice-cream parlour Sundae Royale. These will open in the third quarter of 2025. Pairet’s compatriot, renowned pasty chef Pierre Herme, opens his first Singapore outpost at Weave with a two-storey outlet on Aug 1. Local brands, opening later in the year, will also be represented, including kidswear label Le Petit Society and traditional snack shop Old Seng Choong, which is slated to launch its first open-concept bakery. “Weave represents a pivotal milestone in our RWS 2.0 transformation journey as we reimagine how guests experience luxury and leisure in one seamless environment,” said Ms Lam Xue Ying, vice-president of Singapore Oceanarium and Destination Experience for RWS, in a press statement. She added that it is a space designed to inspire ease and exploration. The mall will be situated next to Universal Studios Singapore and Singapore Oceanarium, taking over the space occupied by RWS’ original shopping area, The Forum. Weave was designed by international architectural firm Benoy and landscape architects from local landscaping firm ICN Design. It was envisioned to be a green destination in multiple ways – featuring actual greenery throughout via green walls and shrubbery-lined walkways, while also incorporating sustainable infrastructure. For instance, the original ethylene tetrafluoroethylene roofing of The Forum has been enhanced for Weave so it deflects more heat and further reduces temperature increases due to ambient sunlight. Additionally, Weave will make use of the cold water by-product generated by the hot water usage in RWS’ hotels to cool the air that feeds into the mall. Weave, named after the weave pattern in the architecture, is part of a larger development plan at RWS. In November 2024, RWS’ holding company, Genting Singapore, held a ground-breaking ceremony for its up-and-coming waterfront development at RWS, slated for completion by 2030. The $6.8 billion project adds more than 164,000 sq m to RWS, including plans to build a Super Nintendo World in Universal Studios Singapore. An 88m-high experiential “mountain trail” and two more hotels with 700 rooms in total are also part of the development.

Here's a summary of the recent status: * Partial Land Sale (June 2025): Genting recently sold a 0.8-acre assemblage in downtown Miami for $20.9 million to SF QOZ Fund I, an Opportunity Zone fund. The buyer plans to develop a luxury apartment tower with retail space, with construction potentially starting in early 2026. This sale is part of Genting's larger effort to offload a significant portion of its Miami land. * Previous $1.2 Billion Deal Fell Through (June 2023): A much larger deal for approximately 15.5 acres (the former Miami Herald headquarters site) with Smart Miami City LLC for $1.225 billion fell through in June 2023. The purchaser had sought an extension and amendments to the commercial terms, which were not granted. While Smart Miami City LLC reportedly remained interested, a new deal for that specific parcel has not been announced. * Genting's Strategy: Genting has stated that it will review other opportunities to sell the remaining Miami land "as-is" while continuing to enhance its remaining holdings. They believe the value of their investment in Miami has increased significantly over the past decade and are in no hurry to sell, preferring to await an optimal price (potentially above US$1 billion for the larger parcel). The proceeds from any sales are intended to provide financial flexibility for operations and future investments, including their focus on securing a full casino license in New York.

body: Based on the available information, Genting Resort World New York (RWNYC) consistently demonstrates higher revenue compared to MGM Yonkers (Empire City Casino). Here's a breakdown: Revenue: * Resorts World New York City: In 2023, RWNYC was the highest-grossing commercial casino outside Nevada in the United States, generating more than US$900 million in revenue. It also had a clear NYC market share leader at 62%. * MGM Yonkers (Empire City Casino): While specific 2023 revenue for Empire City Casino isn't explicitly stated as a top figure, it was ranked No. 6 among non-Nevada commercial casinos in the U.S. in 2023. MGM projects its annual gross gaming revenue to reach over $1 billion once its proposed expansion is complete by mid-2029, which would be a 50% increase over Empire City's current $650 million. This implies that its current revenue is around $650 million, significantly less than RWNYC's $900+ million. Profits: * While direct comparative profit figures for both individual properties are not readily available, the revenue disparity strongly suggests that Resorts World New York City likely has higher profits as well. Higher revenue generally translates to higher profits, assuming similar operating margins. * It's worth noting that Genting Malaysia, the parent company of RWNYC, reported a decrease in net profit in 2024 for the overall group, but this was due to various factors affecting its global operations, not necessarily specific to RWNYC's profitability. In fact, RWNYC's LBITDA (Loss Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization) narrowed from US21 million in 2023 to US7 million in 2024, indicating an improvement in its operational performance. In summary, Genting Resort World New York has a clear advantage in terms of revenue, and it is reasonable to infer that it also holds the lead in profits.

author: Joo1818
body: Resorts World New York (RWNY), which currently operates as a Video Lottery Terminal (VLT) facility, is in the process of bidding for a full commercial casino license in New York. The tax obligations associated with this are multi-faceted: 1. Licensing Fees: * Application Fee: There is an initial non-refundable application fee of $1 million. * Licensing Fee (if awarded): If RWNY is successful in securing one of the new downstate commercial casino licenses, they will be required to pay a minimum licensing fee of $500 million to the state. 2. Gaming Tax Rates: Currently, as a VLT facility, Resorts World New York City has specific tax allocations for its net win. For example, a significant portion goes to the State Education Fund (e.g., 40%), with other percentages allocated to agent commissions, marketing, and capital awards. However, if they are granted a full commercial casino license, the tax structure will change. Based on information from recent bids and proposed regulations in New York: * Electronic Devices (Slots/VLTs): New York imposes a high effective tax rate of 55% on electronic gaming devices. * Table Games (e.g., Blackjack): The minimum tax rate for other gaming sources, such as table games, is 10% of gross gaming revenue. 3. Projected Tax Contributions: Resorts World has stated that if granted a full casino license, they anticipate contributing over $1 billion annually in taxes to the state. This is a significant increase from the over $600 million they contributed in 2023 as a VLT facility. They have indicated that they will continue to contribute around 67% of their slot machine revenue to the state, with the addition of table games pushing the overall tax contributions past the $1 billion mark. In summary, for a full commercial casino license, RWNY would need to pay a substantial one-time licensing fee (at least $500 million) in addition to ongoing gaming taxes on their gross gaming revenue, which are expected to be significantly higher for electronic devices compared to table games.

body: Resorts World New York City (RWNYC) appears to be a highly profitable concern, especially in terms of generating revenue for New York State. This significant investment signals strong confidence in the profitability and growth potential of the existing and expanded resort. They project to contribute over $1 billion to the MTA and continue supporting public education with this expansion. * Strategic Location: Its location in the dense New York City market is a key factor in its success, drawing a large number of visitors. * "Shovel-Ready" Status: The company emphasizes its "shovel-ready" status for expansion, implying a readiness to quickly capitalize on a full casino license and generate immediate additional tax revenue and jobs. While specific net profit figures for the resort itself are not always publicly detailed in the provided search results (as much of the revenue goes to state education funds and other entities), the consistent high revenue generation, significant contributions to the state, and the ambitious expansion plans strongly indicate that Resorts World New York City is a very successful and profitable operation for Genting Malaysia.

body: KUALA LUMPUR (July 7): A lawsuit filed in the US against Genting Malaysia Bhd (KL:GENM) by its business partner RAV Bahamas Ltd has been dismissed, though the court opened the door for an amended complaint. The court agreed with Genting Malaysia’s position that the complaint in its initial form was “merely a shareholders’ dispute” in a decision on July 1, and that RAV Bahamas' current allegations are “baseless and without merit”, according to Genting Malaysia in an exchange filing on Monday. However, the US District Court, Southern District of Florida gave RAV Bahamas one last opportunity to revise its complaint before making its final ruling to toss out the lawsuit, Genting Malaysia said. In October 2024, Genting Malaysia’s indirect unit Genting Americas Inc, which operates Resorts World Bimini in the Bahamas, was named in a complaint by RAV Bahamas in the court. RAV Bahamas alleged that Genting Americas has turned RW Bimini into a “financial wasteland” by dumping almost US$1 billion of debt into it, Bahamas’ news portal The Tribune reported. RAV Bahamas is seeking damages of more than US$600 million (RM2.57 billion) from Genting Americas. Resorts World Bimini is owned and operated by BB Entertainment Ltd, in which Genting Malaysia indirectly holds a 78% stake, while RAV Bahamas holds the remaining 22% stake. Genting Americas, which is incorporated in Delaware in the US, is an affiliate company of BB Entertainment. Shares of Genting Malaysia were traded down one sen or 0.5% to RM2 at 2.43pm on Monday, valuing the group at RM11.88 billion.

DBS downgrades Genting Singapore to ‘hold’, trims target price on tariffs dampening outlook Analysts expect a more subdued performance for H2 FY2025 than previously forecast, given tariff threats, macroeconomic risks and a potential ousting from the MSCI Singapore Index Beyond near-term earnings pressures, the “lingering risk” of being ousted from the MSCI Singapore Index threatens to cap Genting Singapore’s share price gains, the analysts said. This comes as the company’ share price decline pushed its float-adjusted market capitalisation to around S$4.4 billion, which is the lowest among existing MSCI Singapore constituents. The counter has fallen 3.3 per cent year to date from its closing price of S$0.765 on Dec 31, 2024. While the current cut-off market capitalisation threshold for inclusion is not known, the analysts noted that it is likely to have risen above the previous cut-off of around S$4.75 billion during the May 2024 review. This is due to the rally of developed markets. “Given this, we believe Genting Singapore faces a credible risk of exclusion in the upcoming MSCI review, with the next announcement scheduled for Aug 7, 2025, and any changes to take effect on Aug 27, 2025

author: Michaelchan2024
body: Business Times just reported a blowout performance from Marina Bay Sands (MBS)... H1 2025 revenue jumped 17% to US$2.6 billion, and adjusted property EBITDA soared 23.8% to US$1.4 billion! That’s up from US$1.1 billion in H1 2024. They called it a record financial and operating performance, and you can see why. Average daily room rates hit US$888, and RevPAR (revenue per available room) climbed to US$844, up from US$759 in Q2 2024. Clearly, travel and tourism spending in Asia is roaring back. Now, this is exciting for the overall industry… but when you think about Genting Singapore (G13), it might actually be a bit worrying. Every time MBS posts exceptional results like this, G13 tends to come off looking weaker by comparison — sometimes even showing a loss in market share. So naturally, this raises some concerns ahead of G13’s Q2 2025 financial results.

author: ImCK
body: The Group did not acquire a controlling stake then because otherwise Empire would not be able to preserve its tax losses amounting to USD400 million which is valuable for the future tax deduction purposes. Notwithstanding that the Group did not have equity control, the Group had management control via a management agreement for the Group to manage the day-to-day operations of RWC. At the time of the acquisition of Empire, the Group had already participated in the New York gaming market for more than eight (8) years, but did not hold a full-scale casino licence. Therefore, the acquisition made sense for the Group, as it allowed the Group to expand and reinforce its presence in the New York State gaming market to compete effectively in the northeastern US region by utilising both properties at Catskills and RWNYC. The Group was also cognisant of the fact that three (3) additional casino licences may potentially be issued for downstate New York. The Group believed that it would be in a far better position to compete in the future with at least the two (2) properties, RWNYC and RWC. Specifically, the acquisition provided the following benefits: (a) With an existing team managing a full-scale casino, the Group would be able to deploy the team very quickly if the Group was successful in its bid for a New York Downstate casino licence; (b) The Group would realise operating synergies, consisting of revenue synergies through cross-marketing and cost synergies via shared services between RWNYC and RWC; (c) Empire came with a licence to operate a VLT facility in Newburgh, Orange County. Resorts World Hudson Valley (“RWHV”) commenced operations in December 2022 with 1,200 VLTs, and has been very profitable with EBITDA of USD15 million for financial year 2024 against an investment cost of just USD50 million; and see what i mention they will move RW catskill skilled employee to RWNYC once secure commercial lisence casino no need hiring and train new staff 😁😁😁

author: ImCK
body: The funding costs were very high during the COVID-19 pandemic. Hence, GENM had to inject a total of USD310 million into Empire to reduce its debt as part of a recalibration of its capital structure to further improve its profitability. Notably, with the Group’s involvement, Empire recorded EBITDA of USD30 million in financial year 2021 post- COVID-19, compared to losses of USD43 million in the previous financial year. In the following financial year 2022, EBITDA improved to USD40 million. The equity injections by GENM into Empire to address the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic amounted to USD460 million, comprising USD150 million to fund operating losses and USD310 million to pare down debts. This represents about 60% of GENM’s total investment todate of USD766 million in Empire. The balance of USD306 million was consideration paid to Kien Huat of USD280 million and Empire’s minority shareholders of USD26 million to acquire full control of Empire. For the financial years 2023 (“FY 2023”) and 2024 (“FY 2024”), Empire’s EBITDA reduced due to higher payroll costs following the renewal of contracts with the Labour Union but revenue continued to grow, with gross gaming revenue for RWC and RWHV in aggregate improving by 22% and 3% in FY 2023 and FY 2024, respectively. GENM had recently announced the completion of the acquisition of Kien Huat’s remaining stake in Empire for a consideration of USD41 million, bringing the total investment by GENM to USD766 million. As part of the consideration for the acquisition, it was also worth noting that Kien Huat is foregoing the repayment of USD39.7 million loan owed to it by Empire. With full control, GENM is able to unlock full synergies of these two (2) properties. More importantly, Empire’s credit rating had improved by 2 notches from B- to B+ (Fitch rating) when it issued the USD300 million bond in 2021. With the Group owning 100% of Empire, this will further improve Empire’s credit rating by leveraging on the broader Genting Group’s credit rating. This will significantly improve the refinancing opportunity of Empire’s USD300 million bond due in November 2026, which the Group is actively exploring now whole story here from loss to ebitda positive after injected 13 year waiting just for this oppurnity 😁😁😁 The Group believes that New York City will be one of the largest casino markets in the world, estimated by experts to be in excess of USD5 billion in annual gross gaming revenue, on top of approximately USD4 billion gaming revenue currently in New York State.
